hero.headline.value: I make software safe to run when you can't fully trust what it will do.

hero.deck.value: Selected work in agent infrastructure, commerce systems, and developer tooling.

hero.summary.value: I build the controls for software that acts on its own. After unreviewed agent commits reached main, I designed the checks that stop it and open-sourced them as prx: agent changes land as merged pull requests, each git write checked against the capability the agent holds.

bio.origin.value: I read architecture and sculpture before I wrote software, and both are trainings in deciding where a thing ends — which is most of what the work above is.

case.bounded-systems.problem.value: Agent-authored commits reached main without review, and afterwards nobody could say which writes the agent had been authorized to make.

case.bounded-systems.intervention.value: Moved privileged git effects behind capability-checked operations, and routed the work through one pipeline whose only exit is a merged pull request.

case.bounded-systems.evidence.value: prx drives a work unit to an attributed pull request; ocap-provenance records which capabilities each effect held, and which were denied. Both are public, and both name what is still outside the check.

case.bounded-systems.role.value: System model, schemas, implementation, and the operational testing.

case.commerce-systems.problem.value: A 9-tab spreadsheet was the supply plan of record, and three teams each read it differently.

case.commerce-systems.intervention.value: Replaced it with a CLI over one source of truth — 61 schema contracts, 173 test scenarios — and automated the inbound freight it had been gating.

case.commerce-systems.evidence.value: The three teams now plan against the same document, and freight moves without the manual coordination that used to hold shipments.

case.commerce-systems.role.value: Contract design, the CLI, and the cross-team consolidation.

case.developer-systems.problem.value: Whole classes of defect were being found after merge, by people, one ticket at a time.

case.developer-systems.intervention.value: Moved static analysis into the pull-request pipeline as a blocking gate, so those classes could not reach main in the first place.

case.developer-systems.evidence.value: Critical bugs fell 20% — critical-severity tickets per quarter, the four quarters before against the four after.

case.developer-systems.role.value: Gate design, the CI implementation, and the developer-experience work that kept the gate from being routed around.

exp.empathic.what.value: Infrastructure for operating software that changes behavior after it ships. Agent sandboxing enforced by the operating system, and the tooling teams need to run low-trust code with confidence.

exp.aura.what.value: The team owns the company's website and business-operations systems on a Ruby backend, spanning fulfillment, accounting, and third-party integrations. I build the automation on AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFront) and the contract-and-validation layer behind inventory-purchasing.

exp.aura.b0.value: Wrote the CLI that replaced the company's 9-tab spreadsheet supply plan with a single source of truth — 61 schema contracts checked by 173 test scenarios — to bring down the peak cash tied up in inventory.

exp.aura.b1.value: Aligned fulfillment, accounting, and ops on a single supply plan — the consolidation took as much cross-team coordination as it did engineering.

exp.aura.b2.value: Automated the inbound supply chain — ocean freight into the 3PL, Amazon LTL, and the freight splits between them — retiring the manual coordination that gated most shipments.

exp.aura.b3.value: Reconstructed how agent-authored commits slipped past review — traced each across five log sources, wrote the post-mortem, and designed the controls that informed the company's policy for shipping AI-written code.

exp.l2l.what.value: Owned the quality gates and developer experience for a 20-engineer team on a Python/Django backend, deployed single-tenant per customer (EC2/ECS, RDS, S3, Lambda). Drove static-analysis CI, a design system, and frontend-performance work.

exp.l2l.b0.value: Shipped static-analysis gating into the PR pipeline. It blocks whole defect classes before merge, instead of catching them after. Critical bugs fell 20% — critical-severity tickets per quarter, four quarters before vs. after.

exp.pioneer-works.what.value: Built the event-planning platform's backend for a major Brooklyn arts center — Python and JavaScript on AWS Lambda and Postgres, integrating Square POS over webhooks.

exp.pioneer-works.b0.value: Replaced hand-set event-status flags with state derived from each department's POS activity, so status stayed correct across the venue's large concerts without manual updates.

exp.kaleida.what.value: Built the just-in-time production automation for an augmented-reality and print-making studio on Postgres, with heavy third-party API integration.

exp.kaleida.b0.value: Eliminated edition-numbering errors. A database issued serial edition IDs on request, making duplicates impossible by construction.

exp.recurse-center.what.value: Studied type theory in Haskell, using the type system to make invalid states unrepresentable. It's the root of the capability work: push correctness to the boundary, and violations can't compile.

exp.scope-of-work.what.value: Built the job-postings CMS behind the manufacturing publication's newsletter, and the publication's customer segmentation, on Postgres — integrating outside tools through their APIs.

exp.scope-of-work.b0.value: Designed the schema that moved spreadsheet data into a relational database, so a malformed record couldn't be written.

proj.prx.desc.value: An agent pipeline that drives work units to merged PRs. Each git write is checked against the capability the agent holds. Moved from a Rust predecessor to TypeScript once the key contracts proved to be between systems, not machine and kernel.

proj.ocap-provenance.desc.value: Extends SLSA/in-toto provenance with object-capability semantics, built in TypeScript. Each attestation records who produced an artifact and which capabilities they held — and which were denied.

work.prx.value: The agent-run work-unit CLI: capability-scoped agents whose privileged effects are verified against a signed owner, driving a work unit through one signed pipeline to a merged PR.

work.guest-room.value: Guest-agnostic room+door capability runtime — an agent reaches the outside world only through the door references it's handed.

work.claude-box.value: A capability-secured box for agent sessions — its authority is the door references it holds (keeper/scout/concierge/net), parent-agnostic.

work.door-kit.value: In-box door-client SDK for claude-box's capability doors (keeper/scout/concierge/spawn), over the guest-room protocol.

work.ocap-provenance.value: Capability-use provenance — a schema + SLSA mapping binding each privileged effect to a signed owner and an auditable chain.

work.string-audit.value: Cost-aware, grounded content auditor — typed string symbols, type-scoped audits, CAS-memoized LLM calls.
